waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: every behaviour change that breaks it also breaks a property above it (the trial's commit no longer being the tip plus its prefix is no-abort-on-remove).

mutations.name: take-any-run-s-result
mutations.why: The result of a check run is taken for the trial under way without comparing the commit it ran on: the late green of a trial dropped at a base move stands for a commit never tested.

mutations.name: memo-not-keyed-by-the-base
mutations.why: What the queue learned is kept when it reads a new base tip, as if a verdict held for the entries whatever they were built on.
mutations.replace:
/\ tip' = main
    /\ memo' = {<<main, m[2], m[3]>> : m \in memo}

mutations.name: no-abort-on-remove
mutations.why: An entry withdrawn out of the commit under test leaves the trial running: its result is then recorded for the entries that remain, which were never built together.
mutations.search: IF trial.stage = "test" /\ Index(flight, e) <= trial.len THEN Idle ELSE trial

mutations.name: carry-memo-past-an-outside-push
mutations.why: After a landing the queue carries what it knew onto the new tip although someone pushed on top of its commit meanwhile: an entry is failed on a tip it was never tested on.

mutations.name: land-what-is-not-known-red
mutations.why: Bisection lands everything before the first prefix known red instead of the longest prefix known green: an untested prefix reaches the base.

mutations.name: base-read-while-landing
mutations.why: A new base tip is taken while the queue's own push is under way: the queue forgets the push and builds its landed entries again on top of themselves.

mutations.name: newest-first-batch
mutations.why: A batch takes the newest entries of its goal instead of the oldest, so a later branch lands before an earlier one.
mutations.replace: take == SubSeq(group, Len(group) - Least(BatchSize, Len(group)) + 1, Len(group))

mutations.name: withdraw-while-landing
mutations.why: An entry is withdrawn while the commit that holds it is being pushed: the queue calls it removed and it is on the base.

mutations.name: landed-without-reading-the-base
mutations.why: The queue calls a prefix landed without the base holding its commit (a push that was refused or never ran).

mutations.name: forced-push
mutations.why: The push no longer has to be a fast-forward: a commit built on an old tip replaces what others pushed since.

mutations.name: drop-fairness
mutations.why: Nothing makes the queue take its next step, so entries may wait for ever.
